fixes.explanation: Elijah, a prophet of Israel, is a name that jumps out, so I get the pick, friend. But he never shows up in this letter. Paul says they "…await His Son from heaven…" (1 Thessalonians 1:10). So the Thessalonians have their eyes on the sky for God's Son, and nobody else is on their list.

Ha, this one is sneaky, friend, because the statement is true! Paul says they await His Son from heaven, "…whom He raised from the dead…" (1 Thessalonians 1:10). It's one Son, not two. The One they're waiting for is the very One God raised, so True was the pick here.
